samples.question: Read the three shapes nearest the gold dock along its navy run: circle, square, triangle. Continue along that run through all six short gate bars. A bar above the rail swaps the first and second shapes; a bar below swaps the second and third. Apply the gates in traversal order. Then read each colored-dock run away from its dock. Which dock shows the resulting shape order? Answer red, green, or blue.
